name: muster
description: Muster: rooms where people agree on a payment, a bill split or a decision, then settle it. Publishes muster_module and muster_ui, and the private multisig's provers, lez_msig_module (LEZ v0.3) and lez_msig_v04_module (LEZ v0.4), optional, linux-amd64; every other dependency comes from the official Logos catalogue. Unsigned.
